text:
marcus: Quick follow-up from today's security all-hands \u2014 consolidating open Qs on SOC2/ISO evidence, KMS/BYOK, and VPC flow logs. Posting short answers + owners.
anya: Auditors asked how we prove integrity & chain-of-custody for exported bundles. What do we produce?
kevin: We attach a signed manifest next to every export with these fields: bundle_id, requested_by, request_ticket, purpose, timestamp, sha256, signer_id, request_reason. The platform signs the manifest. Example manifest (signed):
```{
  "bundle_id": "bndl-2330123456-01",
  "requested_by": "anya",
  "request_ticket": "AUD-1122",
  "purpose": "SOC2 evidence",
  "request_reason": "external auditor request",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T12:34:56Z",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "signer_id": "redwood-svc-key-v3"
}```
kevin: Additionally we write a provenance log that records download events (who downloaded, when, IP) into the audit index; the provenance summary is included in the bundle.
sylvia: For KMS: cloud-managed keys return rotation timestamps and actor ids via the control-plane API. For BYOK/HSM we store vendor attestations per rotation and include a normalized rotation_event in the bundle.
anya: Do we support HSM-backed BYOK for customers?
kevin: Yes but as a pilot first. Ops note: HSMs require extra attestation handling and rotation ops. Proposed: pilot HSM BYOK for two enterprise customers in Q2.
marcus: VPC question: can customers stream VPC flow logs into their SIEM and keep provenance?
sylvia: Yes. We support S3, CloudWatch, and HTTPS destinations. Provide a signed role/endpoint and an IAM least-privilege template. CLI sample: `redwood infra export-flow --vpc vpc-abc123 --to s3://cust-logs/ --role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/RedwoodFlowExport`.
anya: Owners & due dates so we can close loop:
- Publish evidence export FAQ + retention numbers (owner: anya, due: 2026-04-01)
- Implement signed manifest + provenance events (owner: kevin, due: 2026-04-08)
- HSM BYOK pilot scope + attestation schema (owner: kevin + sylvia, due: 2026-06-15)
- Flow log export cookbook + IAM templates (owner: sylvia, due: 2026-03-31)
marcus: Deploy note: audit-service v2.8 rolled out by audit-bot at 2330123530. Tag me on PRs and I'll collate the Confluence stub.
kevin: :thumbsup:
